title: Billing Farm Command Completed
description: A palette command the Farm asked Milkshake to run was handled: planned (nothing written) or applied (the run appended ledger events; an applied outcome may still carry the code of a failure that followed the commit, so the Farm never shows failed for a ledger that changed). Carries the command_id; the full outcome is on the ledger as farm.command.ran and in the next milkshake/v1 snapshot's commands. Never carries args, detail or a reason. Ordered by ledger:<client> (ledger:global while refused before the client was proven). Emitted by milkshake-farm-consumer. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (billing) and Milkshake docs/farm-commands.md section 14.

command.description: The allow-list name; null when the command was refused before its shape was proven.

subject.description: The command subject; null when refused before the shape was proven.

client.description: Null while the command is unverified.

code.description: The refusal or failure code (docs/farm-commands.md 14.12). On an applied outcome it is the failure that followed the committed run (14.7.2 step 9); otherwise null on a success.

message.description: One line: no paths, no secrets, no argument values.

appended.description: Ledger events the run appended under its run actor; null when nothing ran.

requested_by.description: The ledger-verified sender; null when the command was refused before that was proven.

claimed_requested_by.description: The unverified claim in a command refused before proof; null otherwise.

args_sha256.description: sha256(canonical(args)); the arguments themselves never ride the bus.

ledger_recorded.description: Whether the outcome is a farm.command.ran on the ledger.

pushed.description: Whether the snapshot carrying the outcome reached the Farm; null when no push was attempted.
